It establishes an exact sequence relating the torsion of the Jacobian, a specific torsion module MTor, and the character group of the modulus, proving that MTor is isomorphic to a direct sum of Q/Z copies. The section concludes by defining pullback and pushforward maps for these modules in the context of finite morphisms between curves.

knowledge_units.context_summary: The text defines a specific character χ on the group Γ2(p) for primes p ≡ 1 mod 4 and constructs a subgroup Γ′2(p) as the kernel of a product of characters. It establishes that Γ′2(p) is a normal subgroup of Γ0(p) with a cyclic quotient of order 2k. Additionally, it proves properties of modular functions Fh, showing that their squares are defined over Q and have odd orders at cusps.
